note: What the generated bank says. Every text is already in this repository, at the source its group names, under the same id where the source has ids; none comes from a private recording. A text is split at ' ... ' into pieces said apart, with the phrase's pause_s, or its group's, between them. Each piece is given to the voice with a capital first letter and an end mark: the phrase's ends, or else a question mark when the question starts with a question word and a full stop otherwise (tools/bank/generate.py, spoken). say_as respells a word for the voice alone; the take's text keeps the spelling here.
